description: the exact resistance of a unit sphere near a plane wall in a medium of unit viscosity: the force and torque it exerts on the fluid per unit motion about its centre, the wall's normal +z, at the gap d (its surface's height over the radius); from the bispherical solutions (Brenner 1961, Jeffery 1915, Dean and O'Neill 1963, O'Neill 1964), built by scripts/sphere_plane_table.py

entries.xx: translation along the wall (x, as y)
entries.ryry: rotation about an axis along the wall (y, as x)
entries.x_ry: force along x per rotation about y (= torque about y per translation along x; the y-force per rotation about x is its negative)
